source_evidence: Native private overlays against unchanged defac5d8 source tested ordinary destructor before and after close, then token-identical inline destructor delayed until after close. Working inline constructor, arithmetic and configured flags were unchanged. Each trial passed unchanged-replica controls for vector.cpp/veh.cpp and independent compiled header/close damage witnesses under both configured flag sets.

The ordinary-before case emits35/35/44 instructions for add/sub/cross in the first flag set; ordinary-after and delayed-inline remain27/27/36, as current source, versus originals22/22/31. Neither flag set restores matching. Both ordinary cases also replace genuine veh_scoot direct-close cleanup calls with destructor calls. Delayed inline preserves those references but supplies no arithmetic improvement. Reject ordering alone as a restoration route; no candidate was published and all historical matching obligations remain.
